title: filago gallica var. multicaulis
intro: Filago gallica var. multicaulis, commonly known as multiflower cudweed, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing. The health benefits of multiflower cudweed include its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations and protect against free radical damage. The bioactive constituents of Filago gallica var. multicaulis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties.
